ntsc.target: The boot executable SCUS_972.68 and its 27 level programs: every program rebuilds byte for byte from splat's assembly, with the C in src/ linked in place of its functions (one definition per function, at every place it has).

source.name: rac2-decomp

build.host: macOS, Linux or Windows through Docker (linux/386 image with Wine and the build tools); SN ProDG 2.0's assembler and linker you supply

progress.note: Every distinct function of the boot executable and the 27 level programs counted once (a function many levels share is one function); matched when its C links into a program that equals retail.

ntsc.setup: in games/rac2/ntsc: python3 tools/levels.py dump (baserom/SCUS_972.68.iso), tools/compiler/build.sh, python3 tools/compiler/sdk/build.py, then python3 tools/build.py all (docs/BUILDING.md; bash tools/docker/run.sh <command> on hosts without the tools)

pal.target: The PAL release's boot executable SCES_516.07 and its 27 level programs, built from the same tree as v1.01 (tools/build.py --version pal): every program rebuilds byte for byte, with the C of src/ and src/pal/ linked in place of its functions.

progress.note: Every distinct function of the boot executable and the 27 level programs counted once (a function many levels share is one function); matched when its C links into a program that equals retail.

pal.setup: in games/rac2/ntsc: python3 tools/levels.py dump --version pal (baserom/SCES_516.07.iso), tools/compiler/build.sh, python3 tools/compiler/sdk/build.py, then python3 tools/build.py all --version pal (docs/VERSIONS.md; bash tools/docker/run.sh <command> on hosts without the tools)

xmap.setup: python3 tools/levels.py dump --version pal in games/rac2/ntsc
